title: /goal keeps Claude working until a condition holds
try: /goal all tests pass and lint is clean
why: Replaces repeated "continue" prompts on long tasks; it re-checks the condition each turn.

title: /fork copies the conversation into a background session
try: /fork   (then keep working while the copy runs a side task)
why: Explore a risky refactor or a side question without polluting your main context.

title: /loop re-runs a prompt on an interval, or self-paces
try: /loop 5m check the deploy and tell me if it fails
why: Babysitting CI, deploys and PRs without staying in the chat.

title: /code-review reports correctness bugs in a diff
why: A second pair of eyes before you commit; runs as a background subagent.

title: /rewind can summarize earlier context instead of wiping it
why: Keeps the useful part of a long session. Heavy /clear users usually lose context they wanted.

title: /skill-doctor shows what each skill costs in context
why: Plugins and skills load descriptions into every session; prune the ones you never trigger.

title: /usage breaks down limits by skill, subagent, plugin and MCP server
why: Finds the one plugin or MCP server quietly eating your plan.

title: claude agents: one screen for every session
why: See what is running, blocked on you, or done across parallel sessions.

title: fallbackModel keeps sessions alive when a model is overloaded
why: Up to three fallbacks tried in order instead of a failed turn.

title: maxEffortLevel caps reasoning effort everywhere
why: A guard against accidentally running the most expensive effort level on routine work.

title: claude plugin eval tests your plugin against a no-plugin baseline
why: Proves a skill or plugin earns its context cost before you keep it.

title: Mods: plugins that run inside the session (panes, bands, hooks)
try: Ask Claude: "use the plugin-authoring skill to make a mod that ..."
why: Customize Claude Code itself: status bands, tool-call guards, auto-handoff.

title: Codex multi-agent and hooks are config flags
why: Parallel subagents and lifecycle hooks, the same shape as Claude Code's.
